name: design study: on the parametric bracket the variables are listed; T (thickness) chosen as a range 4…12 step 2
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('advParamBracket'); await sleep(1500); await m.run('designStudy'); await sleep(300); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const vars = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ds-var b')].map((b) => b.textContent); q('[data-pm-toggle="ds.on:T"]').click(); await sleep(200); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; fld('ds.min:T', 4); await sleep(150); fld('ds.max:T', 12); await sleep(150); fld('ds.step:T', 2); await sleep(150); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, vars: vars.slice(0, 4), t: m.designStudy.study().vars.T }); })()

name: design study: all combinations of T — the mass grows with the thickness; the table lists five designs
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); q('[data-pm-set="ds.method"][data-value="grid"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm="ds.run"]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && !m.designStudy.result(); i++) await sleep(200); const r = m.designStudy.result(); const masses = r.rows.map((x) => x.sensors.mass); return JSON.stringify({ n: r.rows.length, ts: r.rows.map((x) => x.values.T), rising: masses.every((v, i) => !i || v > masses[i - 1]), table: document.querySelectorAll('.ds-table tr').length }); })()

name: design study: optimise — the lightest design with mass ≥ halfway between T = 6 and T = 8: found between them (finer than the grid), applied, then undone
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); const grid = m.designStudy.result(); const m6 = grid.rows.find((x) => x.values.T === 6).sensors.mass, m8 = grid.rows.find((x) => x.values.T === 8).sensors.mass; const limit = (m6 + m8) / 2; q('[data-pm-set="ds.method"][data-value="optimise"]').click(); await sleep(200); q('[data-pm="ds.addConstraint"]').click(); await sleep(200); const sel = q('[data-pm-select="ds.conSensor:0"]'); sel.value = 'mass'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm-set="ds.conOp:0"][data-value=">="]').click(); await sleep(150); const i = q('[data-pm-field="ds.conValue:0"]'); i.value = String(limit); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(150); m.state.editing.result = null; q('[data-pm="ds.run"]').click(); for (let k = 0; k < 300 && !m.designStudy.result(); k++) await sleep(200); const r = m.designStudy.result(); const best = r.rows[r.best]; q(`[data-pm="ds.apply:${r.best}"]`).click(); await sleep(800); const applied = m.project.parts[0].variables.find((v) => v.name === 'T').expr; await m.actions.undo(); await sleep(800); const back = m.project.parts[0].variables.find((v) => v.name === 'T').expr; return JSON.stringify({ between: best && best.values.T > 6 && best.values.T <= 8, meets: best && best.sensors.mass >= limit, feasible: best?.feasible, applied: applied === String(best?.values.T), back, open: m.state.editing?.mode }); })()

name: design study: a stress sensor — faces kept by signature are found again on every thickness; the thinner bracket is the more stressed (what-if T = 6 / 10)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const q = (s) => document.querySelector(s); q('[data-pm-toggle="ds.sensor:maxStress"]').click(); await sleep(200); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const z = (fc) => fc.center?.z ?? fc.center?.[2] ?? 0; const planar = faces.map((fc, i) => ({ i, fc })).filter((x) => x.fc.geomType === 'PLANE').sort((a, b) => z(a.fc) - z(b.fc)); q('[data-pm="ds.pick:fixtures"]').click(); await sleep(150); m.viewport.options.onPick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: 'body', index: planar[0].i }, {}); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm="ds.pick:loads"]').click(); await sleep(150); m.viewport.options.onPick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: 'body', index: planar.at(-1).i }, {}); await sleep(150); const st = m.designStudy.study(); q('[data-pm-set="ds.method"][data-value="whatif"]').click(); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm="ds.addScenario"]').click(); await sleep(150); q('[data-pm="ds.addScenario"]').click(); await sleep(150); const fld = (k, v) => { const i = q(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`); i.value = String(v); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); }; fld('ds.scVal:0:T', 6); await sleep(120); fld('ds.scVal:1:T', 10); await sleep(120); m.state.editing.result = null; q('[data-pm="ds.run"]').click(); for (let k = 0; k < 600 && !m.designStudy.result(); k++) await sleep(200); const r = m.designStudy.result(); const [a, b] = r.rows; return JSON.stringify({ faces: [st.sim.fixtures.length, st.sim.loads.length], ok: a?.ok && b?.ok, thinner: a && b && a.sensors.maxStress > b.sensors.maxStress, ts: r.rows.map((x) => x.values.T) }); })()
